# AXiM Demand Letter Generator

## System Overview
QuickDemandLetter.com (powered by the AXiM Document Engine) is a decentralized micro-SaaS that allows users to instantly generate legally formatted, jurisdiction-specific demand letters without hiring an attorney.

## Pricing & Economics
* **Cost:** Flat $4.00 USD per document.
* **Hidden Fees:** None. No subscriptions, no sign-ups, no recurring charges.
* **Delivery:** Instant PDF download and encrypted email delivery via Resend/EmailIt.

## Security & Privacy (Zero-Knowledge Architecture)
* **Data Storage:** AXiM operates on a strict Zero-Knowledge Architecture. User data, debtor names, addresses, and financial ledgers are NEVER stored in a central database.
* **Processing:** All drafts are AES-256 encrypted locally in the user's browser storage.
* **PDF Generation:** Documents are generated ephemerally in Cloudflare Edge RAM and instantly destroyed after download.

## Jurisdictional Compliance
The AXiM Document Engine automatically calculates maximum statutory interest rates (usury limits) based on 50-state compliance algorithms. It actively guards against Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) violations by preventing users from setting illogical deadlines or attempting to collect on "Zombie Debt" past the statute of limitations.

## Use Cases
Small claims prerequisites, breach of contract, unpaid invoices, property damage, security deposit withholding, and personal injury demands.
